title: Leaf Disease — Comparative Vision Architectures + Grad-CAM + ONNX/TFLite

modules.dataset: Plant Village downloader + synthetic-image fallback (procedural leaf generator with class-specific disease patterns) + PyTorch Dataset + Albumentations augmentations (train: RandomResizedCrop + flips + brightness/contrast + hue/sat + rotate; val/test: Resize + CenterCrop + Normalize) + stratified train/val/test splits.
modules.model: Three backbones (ResNet50 / EfficientNetV2-S / ViT-B/16) loaded via torchvision's pretrained weights with fresh classification heads. Grad-CAM++ implementation with hooks on the final conv/attention layer, supporting all 3 backbones via dynamic layer path resolution. ONNX export with dynamic batch axis + onnxruntime inference parity check. TFLite export via onnx2tf (optional).
modules.tests: 9 tests (8 passing by default + 1 opt-in CLI smoke): synthetic dataset shape verification, dataloader tensor shapes, stratified split class proportions, all 3 backbones forward pass + param count, ONNX export + runtime parity vs PyTorch (>= 75% label agreement, < 1e-3 max proba diff), Grad-CAM heatmap dimensions + normalization for all 3 backbones, Grad-CAM class_idx=None argmax behavior.
